feeds.title: Street Art News
feeds.description: StreetArtNews, founded in 2009 by Rom Levy, is a premier publication dedicated to urban art, providing comprehensive coverage on street art, graffiti, and related cultural movements. As the definitive guide to the street art world, it features news, exhibition reviews, artist interviews, and in-depth analyses. The editorial team, led by Levy as Editor-in-Chief, has established the platform as a trusted source for art enthusiasts and professionals alike.
